body:
From the #793/#942 follow-up (`fix/793-942-sampling`).

**Tier:** DECISION (@ligon). Residual of #793. The loader, `Country.sampling`, the attrs carrier and the vocabulary freeze landed on `fix/793-942-sampling`.

#### What blocks curation

Per the 2026-10-18 ruling ("Freeze the Uganda exemplar vocabulary as-is"), `lsms_library/sampling.py` freezes `DESIGN_TAGS` to the two values Uganda uses:

```
two-stage-stratified-cluster                 # Uganda 2005-06 .. 2011-12
two-stage-stratified-cluster-rotating-panel  # Uganda 2013-14 onward
```

`SamplingRecord.from_config` treats the triple (`design_tag`, `source_type`, `confidence`) as required **iff any design field is present**, and it refuses a `design_tag` outside that set. So for any other wave there are only two legal records:

- (i) assert a two-stage stratified cluster design; or
- (ii) write a `panel:`-only entry with no design fields at all. That is what GhanaLSS, Ethiopia, Tanzania and Nigeria carry today.

That leaves no way to record any of these:

- **A design looked for and not found.** The population sweep found no statement for 7 of 124 waves (`source_type: not-found`). For population, `universe_tag` has a `not-stated` value for exactly this; `design_tag` has no analogue.
- **A design read off the data** (`source_type: derived-from-data`). The tag would have to claim "two-stage stratified", which the data cannot show. In `.coder/sampling/fingerprint.csv`, 24 of 104 waves (14 countries) have no strata column at all, so even "stratified" is uncorroborated there.
- **A single-stage, unstratified or self-weighting design**, or anything other than the two Uganda shapes. GhanaLSS GLSS1–3 are self-weighting by design (CLAUDE.md, GH #713).

Writing (i) where it is not known would launder an editorial reading into a fact. That is exactly what the triple discipline exists to prevent. So, in practice, **no non-Uganda design record can be written** until the vocabulary is widened.

#### Options

- **A. Add a `not-stated` sentinel tag**, valid only with `source_type: not-found` or `derived-from-data`. This mirrors `population.UNIVERSE_TAGS`. Smallest change; it unblocks recording "looked, nothing found".
- **B. Widen to a small structural vocabulary**, e.g. `single-stage-cluster`, `two-stage-cluster` (unstratified), `two-stage-stratified-cluster[-rotating-panel]`, `stratified-random`, plus A's `not-stated`. Each addition carries a reason in `sampling.py`, per the module's own rule.
- **C. Make `design_tag` optional when `source_type` is `not-found`.** The triple then travels as (`null`, `not-found`, `low`). This loosens the "never travels alone" invariant.

Whichever option is chosen, `tests/test_sampling.py::TestTheVocabularyIsFrozenFromUganda` pins the freeze **in both directions**: every frozen value must be used by a shipped file. So a widened value must ship with at least one record that uses it.

#### After the decision (tier C)

1. Probe the NADA per-study DDI endpoint (`study_desc.method.data_collection.sampling_procedure`) from an environment with WB egress, for the ~90 waves whose catalog id `provenance.py` records.
2. Curate the issue's `evidence.csv` per country, richest-documented first.
3. Wire the missing `strata` columns: Albania, Burkina Faso, GhanaLSS, Mali, Niger and Tajikistan have waves with `n_strata = 0`; Kazakhstan, Kosovo, China, Azerbaijan, Senegal and Pakistan have none at all.

comments.body:
**RULING (@ligon, 2026-10-19): option A now, then B one tag at a time.**
- **Now:** add the `not-stated` sentinel `design_tag`. It is valid only with `source_type: not-found` or `derived-from-data`, mirroring `population.UNIVERSE_TAGS`.
- **Then:** add each structural tag (`single-stage-cluster`, unstratified `two-stage-cluster`, `stratified-random`, self-weighting, ...) only together with the first evidenced record that uses it, with its reason written in `sampling.py`. The freeze test's both-directions rule stays: every allowed tag is used by a shipped record.
- **Not C:** `design_tag` never travels without its `source_type` / `confidence`.

The likely first B addition is GhanaLSS GLSS1-3 (self-weighting, #713).

title: DECISION (#793 residual): the frozen `DESIGN_TAGS` (2 values) cannot express an undocumented or single-stage design, so no non-Uganda design record can be written until it is widened
